recurring_harms: injury from delayed or wrong escalation;discrimination from proxy targets and historical data;opportunity loss for people who never used the product;privacy loss from sensitive free text
human_in_loop_decisions: Any decision that removes a person from a queue, downgrades urgency, rejects an applicant or hands control back to a human in seconds must carry a named human decision record with time, information and authority to override
strongest_guardrails: A deterministic safety rule outside the model that can only escalate, a hard no-automatic-closure limit, subgroup evaluation as a release gate, vendor change control with version pinning, and a pause authority that does not need vendor approval
cross_industry_pattern: Across all three industries the model was rarely the first thing to fail: the target variable, the vendor change process and the operator workflow failed first, so release roadmaps moved evaluation, subgroup reporting and change control ahead of accuracy work and made human oversight capacity a staffing line item rather than a design claim
